#157 · Volcano Pokémon

Typhlosion

Fire

Johto · Generation 2

Typhlosion is a Fire-type Volcano Pokémon first found in Johto (Generation 2). It stands 1.7 m tall and weighs 79.5 kg. It evolves from Quilava. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (109), with a base stat total of 534.
